Brewster was officially incorporated on April 29, 1910. In 1811, David Stewart of Astor's Pacific Fur Company established Fort Okanogan, the first American post in Washington, just north of the present site of Brewster. In 1859, the area experienced a gold rush and by 1880, steamboats became a common sight on the Columbia River as far North as Brewster.
